name: Orange Peel Herbal 100g Face Pack | Removes dirt from skin pores  and Helps Promotes healthier and younger skin
original_description:
Herbal Orange Peel Powder is known have effective astringent properties. The paste has to be massaged on the skin for the cleaning action which may help to clean the pores. The powder may help to add a natural glow to the face. In fact, the paste can even be applied to the hair which may help to make it soft and manageable. Pure, Natural & Safe.

Orange Peel  NATURAL FACE CLEANSER & BLEACH

  • Removes dirt from skin pores
  • Rich source of vitamin C
  • Promotes healthier and younger skin
  • Acts as a natural bleach that lightens dark blotches on skin
  • Reduces suntans & protects skin from harmful UV rays

How to use Orange Peel Herbal Face Pack

  • Take required powder, Add water for oily skin or Milk for dry skin. Make a thin paste.
  • Apply on face and neck.
  • Keep it for 20 minutes or till it dries.
  • Wash with warm water and rinse with cold water.
